full_details: The York page from Monday was still on the board. You did not begin the prison, the garden, or the end. In the afternoon you played in Errors, and the house was thin. After it, Sly had a cousin's letter three weeks old. At a place in Monaghan, Tyrone's men had fallen on Bagenal's column and mauled it two days running. Sly did not believe the letter's numbers, and you wrote none of them down. There was talk that Tyrone is to be proclaimed traitor, and talk of pressing men for Ireland before harvest. George said a relief column is the worst place God made, and he kept what came by a household's letter apart from what strangers had added. Raye, over from the other bank, said the Rose had a new play, a second part of Caesar. Richard said Rome sells. You had Plutarch at home in unbound sheets, and you said nothing about it.
one_sentence: You played in a thin Errors, and in the tiring-house heard Monaghan from a letter and Caesar from over the water.
title: A thin Errors, and a letter three weeks old
